criteria.silhouette_scale: Squat layered fold silhouette with broad top; appropriate inventory material rather than a world block.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Single transparent sprite supported by native generated-item extrusion.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Static textile; no mechanisms or moving clearance.
criteria.period_materials: Ivory woven wool and blue selvage suit a nineteenth-century textile workshop.
criteria.family_consistency: Keeps established ivory/indigo silhouette and folds, restoring subordinate oatmeal/cream material variation.
criteria.controls_readability: Sparse staggered weave clusters interrupt the blank center; lower contrast than fold seams and band. Native comparison preserves broad form.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Only artwork for existing wool-derived cloth.
